title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision <timestamp>: Error: Timed out after ~288-295s waiting for Blazor page/WASM root session to become interactive/attach. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: Both tests time out after ~299 seconds waiting for a Blazor WASM root debug session to attach. This is a timing-related environmental issue in the VS Code extension's Blazor browser debugger E2E infra, not caused by the PR which only touches Aspire.Dashboard Razor/CSS/test files. This exact pattern has recurred 20 times previously across multiple resources (standalone, hosted-global, hosted-per-page).
failure_details:
**Test:** Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global
**Error:** Failed to apply E2E control revision 1789712257741: Error: Timed out after 299565ms waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource 'hosted-global'. Last error: <none>.

**Test:** Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-per-page
**Error:** Failed to apply E2E control revision 1789712257744: Error: Timed out after 299609ms waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource 'hosted-per-page'. Last error: <none>.

Both include full debug session state JSON showing a monovsdbg_wasm 'Wasm Managed Debugger' session configured for browser platform, launched via ws://127.0.0.1:<port>, never reaching an attached state within the timeout window.
